questions.stem: What does a gross profit margin of 40% indicate?

options.text: 40% of revenue is profit after all expenses.
40% of revenue is profit before expenses.
40% of costs are covered by revenue.
40% of revenue is used for taxes.

questions.explanation: A gross profit margin of 40% means that 40% of the revenue remains after deducting the cost of goods sold, before other expenses are considered.

distractorRationale.a: This describes net profit margin, not gross profit margin.
distractorRationale.c: This is incorrect as gross profit margin relates to profit, not cost coverage.
distractorRationale.d: Taxes are not considered in gross profit margin calculations.

questions.stem: If a company's current ratio is 2:1, what does this imply?

options.text: The company has twice as many liabilities as assets.
The company has twice as many assets as liabilities.
The company has equal assets and liabilities.
The company's assets are half its liabilities.

questions.explanation: A current ratio of 2:1 indicates that the company has twice as many current assets as current liabilities, suggesting good short-term financial health.

distractorRationale.a: This is the opposite of what a 2:1 ratio indicates.
distractorRationale.c: This would be a 1:1 ratio, not 2:1.
distractorRationale.d: This is incorrect as it reverses the relationship.

questions.stem: How would an increase in the acid-test ratio be interpreted?

options.text: The company is becoming less liquid.
The company is becoming more efficient in using its inventory.
The company is improving its ability to meet short-term obligations without relying on inventory.
The company is increasing its reliance on inventory to meet obligations.

questions.explanation: An increase in the acid-test ratio indicates improved liquidity, showing the company can meet short-term obligations without depending on inventory.

distractorRationale.a: An increase in the ratio suggests improved liquidity, not less.
distractorRationale.b: Efficiency in inventory use is not directly measured by the acid-test ratio.
distractorRationale.d: This is incorrect as the acid-test ratio excludes inventory.
